original.statement: By default, system-level ignoreDifferences customizations are now applied to ignore resource updates; set ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates to false to preserve the v2 default behavior.

of.needed: whether argocd-cm defines system-level ignoreDifferences customizations (the evidence excerpt does not name the keys that carry them)

corrected.statement: In 3.0, system-level ignoreDifferences customizations also ignore resource updates by default. Exposed: environments with such customizations whose argocd-cm resource.compareoptions does not set ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates. Setting it to false keeps the v2 behaviour.

decision.reason: [ev-63314a5fae82] says that in 3.0 the existing system-level ignoreDifferences customizations are also used to ignore resource updates by default, and that setting `ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates` to false under argocd-cm `resource.compareoptions` keeps the v2 behaviour. Exposed environments are therefore those that have system-level ignoreDifferences customizations and do not set that option. The proposed condition, "`resource.compareoptions` is set", gets this wrong both ways. It flags environments that already set the option, which are shielded. It misses environments that never set `resource.compareoptions`, which get the new default. The excerpt does not give the argocd-cm key names for system-level ignoreDifferences customizations, so that part is left undecidable.
